subject: Fix crash in VM_GetCurrentUserName when no valid user (#1885)
reason: The fix adds a defensive NULL guard to VM_GetCurrentUserName so it returns EINVAL instead of dereferencing ctx->client->user->name when the context has no associated client/user. That NULL-user state only arises for module temp-client contexts (timers, event-loop, server-event callbacks), blocked-client thread-safe contexts, or the replication primary-link client.
